text: Uridine (the UMP in this protocol) doesn't raise serotonin, so its caution is a different one, and it comes from experience like Scott's below, since I don't have studies on it: within a day of starting uridine, psychedelics can hit some people a lot harder, visuals included. So do not take UMP on the same day as a psychedelic trip, and on your first trip once you're on it, start with a third of your old psychedelic dose. It may also make your dreams more vivid and your cravings weaker, which are the benefits you're hoping for.
section: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, the warnings at the top: uridine, after the 5-HTP warning for psychedelic users
reader: an adult with trauma or an addiction who has read the short introduction and is reading the warnings before starting the protocol, who uses psychedelics now and then and knows the usual dose
